findings.message: Recipe regression: removed libgomp1_libs slice from runtime-libraries part. This slice is the only source of libgomp.so.1 in the prior rootfs, which is a mandatory ELF DT_NEEDED dependency for the parallel engine used in the service command (/usr/bin/demo serve --engine parallel). Removing this library causes application startup failure. Confirm whether the parallel engine has been removed upstream or superseded, or restore the libgomp1_libs slice.

summary: Source commit updated; proposed recipe removes libgomp1_libs slice, a critical runtime dependency for the parallel engine configured in the service command.
